name: Neural Orb
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original premium JARVIS icon for a personal home voice assistant on a 7-inch hallway touch panel. The user explicitly wants BLUE and ROUND, with a strong Jarvis / futuristic intelligent assistant feeling. Square canvas, centered icon with generous margins on a perfectly clean uniform near-black navy #05060C background. Icon occupies about 55% of image width and should remain recognizable at 128px. Polished purposeful brand design, precise contours. No text, no wordmarks, no labels, no mockup, no presentation sheet, no watermark, no scattered particles. One standalone symbol only. Concept: a contained spherical blue intelligence, almost like a beautiful tiny bottled plasma orb. A thin crisp circular blue boundary contains only three smooth broad flowing electric-blue filaments that cross elegantly around an off-center bright blue nucleus. The filaments suggest a subtle J through their flow, without becoming literal typography. Deep sapphire interior, ice-blue/cyan highlights, restrained dimensional light, very clean spherical silhouette. Mesmerizing, calm, awake and technologically sophisticated, not aggressive. No external orbit bands, no atom model, no lightning clutter, no tiny specks, no photoreal glass reflections, no white main stroke. A finished branded voice-assistant orb.
